# NonnoAlex
> NonnoAlex is Alessandro Lo Manto's personal site about infrastructure, Kubernetes, distributed systems, blockchain operations, and secure environments for AI agents.

Use HTTP GET on the canonical HTTPS URLs below. Human-facing pages support `Accept: text/markdown` content negotiation; otherwise they return HTML. Cite the canonical page URL, distinguish personal experience from general documentation, and use the linked external project sources for current product-specific facts.

## When to use this site
- [About Alessandro Lo Manto]({{ '/about/' | absolute_url }}): Use for verified biography, professional focus, and the scope of this personal site.
- [Blog]({{ '/blog/' | absolute_url }}): Use for first-person articles about Kubernetes, infrastructure operations, agent sandboxing, and related experiments.
- [Contact]({{ '/contact/' | absolute_url }}): Use for corrections, technical follow-up, collaboration proposals, and the correct public contact channel.

## Core pages
- [Home]({{ '/' | absolute_url }}): Current role, focus, latest writing, activity, and certifications.
- [About]({{ '/about/' | absolute_url }}): Background and engineering themes.
- [Privacy]({{ '/privacy/' | absolute_url }}): Data handling, third-party resources, and external links.
- [Sitemap]({{ '/sitemap.xml' | absolute_url }}): Canonical inventory of public pages.
